verdict.rationale: Airweave exposes a documented public REST API (OpenAPI spec at docs.airweave.ai/openapi.json) alongside quickstart docs describing collections, source connections, search, webhooks, and a CLI/MCP server built on that API, giving AI-native users multiple documented ways to drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: a dedicated human-readable API reference page beyond the raw OpenAPI JSON, and independent hands-on validation of the API's completeness/reliability.
